description: Evaluation set for the multilingual policy RAG pipeline. Paired English/German cases test that the same question is answered equally well in either language. Populate 'relevant_doc_ids' with chunk ids from results/classical_output.json to enable retrieval metrics (hit@k, MRR, nDCG); cases left unlabelled still produce generation, language and judge metrics.

schema.language: expected answer language (ISO 639-1); auto-detected if omitted
schema.pair_id: links a question to its translation, so EN/DE performance can be compared directly
schema.relevant_doc_ids: optional list of ground-truth relevant chunk ids
schema.reference_answer: optional gold answer, enables answer-similarity scoring
